name: admission_received
description: Sent to the parent when an application is recorded.
subject: Application received: {child_name} ({application_ref})
body: Thank you for your application for a place for {child_first_name} in Year {year_group} for {academic_year} ({route}).
We received it on {received_date}. Your reference is {application_ref} - please quote it if you contact us.
We will write to you again once a decision has been made.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
placeholders.received_date: The date the application was received
